properties.name: RECURRENCE (re-measured 2026-10-02, 0.77.0): limitation 15 is the local half of an already-walked cause. A never-exported scratch design answers `--call loop_status` with clean: true, next: [] and no word about exports. Only the opt-in since_export says "No committed record was readable, so EVERY node counts as new"
properties.statement:
Triage agent A, on limitation 15 of art:vscode-call-door-field-report-2026-10-02 ("A design can exist only in its store. Nothing warns when a design has never been exported anywhere"), and on idea 14 ("warn on a never-exported design in loop_status / where-am-i").

② PRECEDENT FOUND, so no new walk: fact:root-cause-a-hosted-session-hears-nothing-about-exports-because-the-only-export-line-rides-a-tracked-export-2026-09-28 measured the local never-exported case on 0.72.0. This decision's counter-arguments already say "A local store that was never exported gets the same silence, so the more general fix may be making loop_status say which case it is in, everywhere". That is idea 14, so idea 14 is a duplicate of this decision's general option and is linked here, not re-minted.

⑤ RE-MEASURED on 0.77.0 (log: /home/ajs7/.claude/jobs/fa666a94/tmp/triage-A/measure.log, L15-*). A scratch store with 2 requirements, never exported. `--call loop_status` → clean: true, next: [], no export key. `--call loop_status --args '{"since_export":true}'` → `since_export.note`: "No committed record was readable, so EVERY node counts as new and this answer is about the whole design rather than a session." The case is detected, but only on request, and it is not reported as owed.

WHAT THE REPORT ADDS: the case is now the door's normal one. Under Copilot alone, with `.reflow2/` git-ignored and no write-through (limitation 4), a design that has never been exported is the default state.

THE TENSION, kept beside it and not resolved here. The accepted blueprint (dec:idea-one-blueprint-the-store-is-the-design-and-an-export-is-a-perishable-photocopy) makes the store the design (rule 1), an export a copy reflow2 never tracks (rule 3) and backup a store-level job (rule 6). Under it, "never exported" is not debt, and the honest warning is about durability: "this design exists on one disk". But step 2 of the door plan (req:a-writing-call-keeps-the-committed-export-current, agreed 2026-10-01, after the blueprint) keeps a committed export current for the door. So which warning loop_status should give a local door design depends on which of those two the owner means to govern it.
